baseline_models.focus_anchor: The chain from أُمِرُوا through يَعْبُدُوا, مُخْلِصِينَ, حُنَفَاءَ, and يُقِيمُوا links directive, exclusive devotion, deliberate inclination, and maintained practice.
baseline_models.mechanism: A directive narrows allegiance to one worshipped object; purification removes shared admixture, hanif supplies active turning, and q-w-m makes that turn a guarded upright posture expressed through recurring prayer and outward giving.

activation_trace.role: The directive image supplies the initiating obligation and bounds the mechanism.
Submissive worship supplies the enacted response rather than mere assent.
The worshipped-one image fixes the single object toward which the response is oriented.
Exclusive separation from sharers makes devotion an unmixed allocation of allegiance.
Inclination toward a side gives the purified allegiance a directional turn.
Care, guardianship, and preservation make uprightness something continually maintained.
Binding ritual prayer supplies the recurring practice that stabilizes the orientation.
Granting and bringing turns the orientation outward as an actual transfer.
Growth and increase make the transfer productive rather than merely subtractive.

changed_reading.before: The ayah is a list of separate ritual duties.
changed_reading.after: The ayah is one conversion-and-maintenance mechanism: allegiance is unmixed and deliberately reoriented, then kept upright through recurring prayer and productive outward transfer.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated دِين and q-w-m forms surround prayer and zakat, placing reckoning, transfer, support, valuation, and even measure inside one construction.
baseline_models.mechanism: D-y-n supplies debt and reckoning, q-w-m supplies social support and valuation, and إيتاء الزكاة supplies a levy whose purity is measured by the growth it enables. The closing phrase can therefore characterize an accountable order, not only private belief.

activation_trace.role: Reckoning and recompense make dīn answerable to outcomes.
Debt and credit give the order an obligation-and-settlement dimension.
Mainstay and subsistence make the order responsible for what keeps persons and society standing.
Valuation and pricing activate q-y-m as an appraisal standard.
Equal weight and even measure sharpen valuation into material fairness.
The imposed-payment image makes giving a concrete public due.
Purity and rectitude qualify the due ethically rather than only fiscally.
Growth and increase supply the due's social effect.

changed_reading.before: Dīn names a private religious identity and zakat is one duty within it.
changed_reading.after: Dīn names an accountable, value-bearing order in which measured obligations, subsistence, purity, and growth are held together.

context_deltas.mechanism: The first context sequence turns exclusive worship into release from divided liens. Covering hides the claim, sharing divides it, f-k-k unlocks a pledged or captive state, and disclosure enables release; the focus then names escape, exclusive allocation, debt, and owned service in the same legal-social field.

activation_trace.role: Owned status makes worship legible as a question of who holds a person's service.
Escape from entanglement supplies the focus-side release event.
Exclusive separation from sharers identifies divided claims as what release removes.
Debt and credit make the divided claims resemble liens awaiting settlement.
Veiling truth supplies the obscured condition from which release must begin.
Participation and shared ownership supply the plural claims opposed by focus-side exclusivity.
Releasing a pledge or captive supplies the legal image of disentanglement.
Appearance and disclosure provide the event that makes the hidden claims visible.

structural_cues: 98:1 places covered and shared affiliations before مُنفكّين and makes the arrival of البينة the temporal boundary.
98:5 answers that sequence with exclusive service, escape-like purification, and dīn.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealment, shared claims, release of a pledge or captive, disclosure, debt, and owned service; I infer that disclosure loosens plural liens so exclusive service can be emancipatory. A live alternative is straightforward doctrinal correction with no redemption mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The command simply replaces disobedience with a new subjection.
changed_reading.after: The command reallocates service away from obscured and divided claims; exclusive devotion is paradoxically a release from plural ownership and unsettled liens.

context_deltas.mechanism: Dispatch, sequential recitation, a written and actively purifying medium, binding inscriptions, and upright contents form a transmission chain. The focus's repeated q-w-m then converts that transmitted standard into guarded bodily and social practice.

activation_trace.role: The directive image makes the focus the executable content of transmission.
Guardianship and preservation turn received norms into maintained practice.
Binding ritual prayer supplies recurrent embodied execution.
Sending and dispatch initiate the movement from source to recipient.
Following in sequence makes recitation a relay rather than static storage.
The written-sheet image supplies the transmissible material surface.
An agent that purifies another makes the medium transformative, not merely clean.
A binding inscription that establishes a judgment gives the contents normative force.
Uprightness and evenness characterize the written standard later enacted in the focus.

structural_cues: 98:2-3 moves from messenger to recitation to purified sheets to upright writings.
98:5 repeats q-w-m in the verb of maintaining prayer and in the closing characterization.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sent messenger, ordered following, a purifying written medium, binding contents, and repeated q-w-m; I infer that the focus practices are the enactment layer that keeps the text standing. A live alternative is that text and duties are adjacent topics without a transmission-to-practice arrow.

changed_reading.before: The ayah merely summarizes commands found in revelation.
changed_reading.after: The ayah is the execution stage of revelation: a purified, upright text becomes a maintained orientation, ritual rhythm, and distributive practice.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context shows disclosure and a joining written order followed by scattering. That sequence distinguishes focus-side purification from indiscriminate separation: kh-l-s removes rival sharing, h-n-f turns toward a side, but q-w-m requires the result to remain coherent and upright.

activation_trace.role: Exclusive separation supplies the necessary boundary against rival allegiance.
Inclination toward one side makes the boundary directional rather than random.
Straightness and balance constrain separation by an upright standard.
Scattering into parts supplies the failed form of separation.
Joining one thing to another supplies the cohesion that scattering undoes.
Disclosure shows that clarity can precede division and therefore cannot by itself secure unity.

structural_cues: 98:4 places تفرّق after receipt of the book and arrival of the clear disclosure.
98:5 immediately follows with purification, directional inclination, and repeated q-w-m.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies joining, disclosure, later scattering, exclusive separation, inclination, and uprightness; I infer a distinction between boundary-making that purifies and fragmentation that dissolves cohesion. A live alternative is that 98:4 only reports a response and does not qualify the focus's exclusivity.

changed_reading.before: Purity means separating as completely as possible from every competing party.
changed_reading.after: Purity is selective boundary work: sever rival claims while preserving an upright coherence, because clarity-driven separation can otherwise harden into factional scattering.

context_deltas.mechanism: The identical permanence construction occurs at both opposed destinations, while the branch inventory adds adhesion and attachment. Focus-side dīn as habit, q-w-m as station, and binding prayer then read as a formation process that makes an orientation adhesive before its destination is disclosed.

activation_trace.role: Habit and customary state make dīn a repeated disposition.
Station and residence turn establishment into settling within a way.
Binding ritual supplies the repetition through which a disposition adheres.
Adhesion and attachment characterize persistence at the negative destination.
The same adhesion image characterizes persistence at the positive destination.

structural_cues: The construction خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا appears in both 98:6 and 98:8 at opposed outcomes.
98:5 places repeated practices between the preceding disclosure and those paired durable states.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies habit, station, binding repetition, and identical adhesion at opposite outcomes; I infer that the focus practices form a durable orientation rather than merely satisfy isolated commands. A live alternative is that khulūd describes only later duration and says nothing about prior habituation.

changed_reading.before: Prayer and zakat are discrete acts whose value is counted after performance.
changed_reading.after: Prayer and zakat are formative repetitions that make a chosen orientation habitual and adhesive, preparing a person to inhabit one of two durable states.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later pairing of secure trust with intentional work opens into interpersonal dealing, reconciliation, fittingness, generosity, and healing. Focus-side maintained prayer and purifying transfer become the recurrent infrastructure by which a created person is repaired and becomes reparative.

activation_trace.role: Granting and bringing make repair materially outward-facing.
Purity and rectitude supply the quality sought through giving.
Care and preservation make repair an ongoing practice rather than a single event.
Security and trust supply the settled interior from which reparative action proceeds.
Dealings between people place good work in a social field.
Reconciliation that removes estrangement supplies the social repair operation.
Generosity and gift connect goodness directly to giving.
Recovery from illness supplies the image of the created person becoming sound.

structural_cues: 98:7 pairs trust with performed rectifying acts before naming the best of creation.
98:5 gives that broad pair a recurring inward practice and a concrete outward transfer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies secure trust, social dealing, reconciliation, generosity, healing, care, and purifying transfer; I infer that the focus practices operationalize social and personal repair. A live alternative is that 98:7's good works remain an unrestricted category with no special causal tie to prayer and zakat.

changed_reading.before: The focus specifies ritual credentials later rewarded by a rank label.
changed_reading.after: The focus specifies a repair regime: guarded worship stabilizes the agent, and purifying transfer turns that stability into reconciliation, generosity, and restored fitness.

context_deltas.mechanism: Debt, levy, valuation, and growth in the focus meet action-matched recompense, collection, nurturing completion, continuing provision, and mutual satisfaction in the final context. The accountable order becomes a circulation of human outgoing value and divine sustaining return, without requiring strict commercial equivalence.

activation_trace.role: Debt and credit supply an open obligation within the focus.
Valuation supplies an accountable standard for what circulates.
The levy image supplies the human outgoing payment.
Growth makes outgoing value capable of producing increase.
Matching an act with its recompense supplies the return side of circulation.
Collecting and satisfying a debt links the return explicitly to focus-side obligation.
Nurturing, repairing, and completing prevent the return from collapsing into flat equivalence.
Continuing provision makes the return sustaining rather than momentary.
Mutual satisfaction transforms settlement into reciprocal relationship.

structural_cues: 98:5 moves from command through giving to دِينُ الْقَيِّمَةِ.
98:8 moves from recompense through continuing flow to the mirrored رضى الله عنهم ورضوا عنه.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies debt, levy, valuation, action-matched recompense, debt collection, nurture, sustained provision, and mutual satisfaction; I infer a circulation from human transfer to divine sustaining return. A live alternative is asymmetrical gift and nurture with no settlement or exchange analogy.

changed_reading.before: Zakat is an isolated due paid within a one-way hierarchy.
changed_reading.after: Zakat is one node in an accountable but non-mercantile circulation: value leaves the worshipper, grows into sustained provision, and culminates in mutual satisfaction.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The race-follower image is branch-distant from ritual prayer, so this is not a lexical gloss of الصلاة. It remains anchored in the focus's prayer and q-w-m construction and is activated by the context's sent messenger, sequential following, and written sheets; downstream prose should present it only as an embodied-relay analogy.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The commanded يُقِيمُوا الصلاة can be heard as maintaining a practice that follows immediately behind the recited message.

activation_trace.role: The racer immediately behind the leader supplies the embodied following image.
Guardianship and preservation make following a maintained relay.
Dispatch supplies the relay's originating movement.
Sequential following supplies the context-side pattern that prayer can embody.
The written sheet supplies what the messenger's recitation carries forward.

changed_reading.before: Prayer is a rite commanded beside the reception of revelation.
changed_reading.after: Prayer is an embodied second runner: it follows the recited message closely enough to carry textual order forward as collective rhythm.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation crosses from the prayer branch to homonymous fire and craft branches, then meets literal fire in 98:6. It remains anchored in الصلاة and q-w-m but does not claim that prayer means fire; downstream prose should qualify it as a controlled-tempering material analogy contrasted with uncontrolled exposure.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins establishing الصلاة to q-w-m uprightness, allowing a branch image of fire-straightening to model repeated correction.

activation_trace.role: Meeting fire and its heat supplies the surprising exposure image within the prayer root.
Heating a stick to straighten it supplies the corrective tempering operation.
Straightness and evenness name the result sought by the tempering analogy.
Blazing fire supplies the uncontrolled context-side exposure against which practice is read.
Flying sparks intensify the contrast between bounded correction and dispersive burning.

changed_reading.before: Establishing prayer means preserving a prescribed schedule.
changed_reading.after: Establishing prayer can also image controlled recurrent tempering: bounded exposure straightens the practitioner before unbounded fire and scattering sparks.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The watercourse reading is a cross-domain mechanism, and one growth cue comes from the packet's non-dominant r-b-b to r-b-w mapping. It remains tightly anchored in focus-side إيتاء, zakat growth, and q-w-m support, then gains visible river and provision cues in 98:8; downstream prose should render it as an ecological analogy, not as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The phrase يُؤْتُوا الزكاة combines a root branch for clearing a watercourse with a root branch for growth, while q-w-m supplies sustaining structure.

activation_trace.role: Clearing and directing a watercourse supplies the focus-side channel operation.
Growth and increase supply the result of opening the channel.
Mainstay and subsistence make the channel an infrastructure of sustained life.
Literal flowing and spreading make the latent channel visible in the final scene.
Continuing provision translates water flow into durable sustenance.
Opening and widening until flow becomes possible supplies the release of blocked circulation.
The non-dominant mapped image of nourishment and growth reinforces the ecological payoff.

changed_reading.before: Giving zakat removes a measured amount from the giver's possession.
changed_reading.after: Giving zakat opens and maintains a social watercourse: released value continues to flow, sustains others, and returns as growth rather than depletion.

strongest_changes: Exclusive worship became release from obscured, shared, and debt-like claims rather than simple replacement subjection.
The messenger-sheet-q-w-m sequence made 98:5 the embodied execution layer of purified written order.
The split between purifying separation and post-disclosure scattering constrained sincerity as selective boundary work.
Debt, valuation, giving, recompense, continuing provision, and mutual satisfaction formed an accountable but non-mercantile circulation.
summary.what_was_special: The focus repeatedly converts inward allegiance into maintained structures: q-w-m links upright texts, established prayer, valuation, and subsistence; legal release and accounting branches expose social mechanics; and the river scene activates a contained hydraulic model of zakat through the packet's non-dominant r-b-w growth mapping.
remaining_uncertainties: The construction دِينُ الْقَيِّمَةِ leaves uprightness, value, maintenance, and exact measure live without deciding which dominates.
The debt-and-recompense mechanism may describe covenantal accountability, but strict transactional equivalence would overstate the packet.
The relay, fire-tempering, and hydraulic readings are inspectable branch analogies, not replacement lexical meanings.
